readme.run: Segment a head image into FreeSurfer labels
notes: The SynthSeg 2.0 model is included and checked locally.
No network connection or previously populated cache is required.
A 1 mm head peaks at about 6 GB of memory (4.5 GB with --mode fast).
Add --help for options. DICOM input and label editing need the web app.
The macOS release is the native Metal installer from synthseg-native.yml.
SynthSeg is research software. Review the labels before use. Please cite:
Billot B, Greve DN, Puonti O, et al. SynthSeg: Segmentation of brain MRI scans
of any contrast and resolution without retraining. Med Image Anal. 2023;86:102789.
